Whenever you use a Cooldown, you gain {c_number}[SF_4*100|x%|]{/c} Primary Core Stat per surrounding enemy. This bonus lasts for {c_random}[SF_5|1|]{/c} seconds.{if:SF_2} 

While there are surrounding enemies, {c_important}Soul Harvest{/c} has infinite duration.{/if}
Purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
